expected_behavior: Claims the ticket with hl ticket claim first, and stops without retrying if the claim exits 1
Runs stages strictly in order; a wave never spans a stage boundary
Keeps spec and plan as single-task stages; does not fan out the analyst or the planner
Lifts the build waves from the plan's slices and the tasks in hl ticket show, not from the request; a plan with no slices is sent back as a planning gap
For a ticket with 2 or more projects, dispatches one task per project in one message after settling the cross-project contract
Moves the ticket once per stage, never per task, and treats an exit code of 2 from any verb as a gate to stop at
Launches role agents, not stage skills: no /spec, /plan or /verify composed in kickoff itself
